body:
## Features
- Nearby building foundations now connect automatically, including single-cell diagonal gaps.
- Added faction-colored foundation accents for Allies, Soviets, China, GDI and Nod.
- Aligned foundation paving across building sizes.
- Dedicated lobbies now wait for a selected or generated map before allowing players to ready up or start.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash when opening Skirmish.
- Fixed Soviet AI handling of construction vehicles and replacement bases.
- Corrected Research Core size and foundation placement.

Update clients and dedicated servers to v0.97.3 before playing together.
